primary_sources.description: Mandatory domestic violence law enforcement response policies
Original enactment — first mandatory DV response policy requirement in California
Major amendment — strengthened mandatory arrest provisions, added victim information card requirements
Amendment adding mandatory report content requirements (six-field checklist)
Mandatory arrest for protective order violations — cross-reference to § 13701 DV arrest policy requirement
Corporal injury to spouse — the primary felony DV charge governed by § 13701 mandatory arrest policy
